_meta.file_purpose: The curated set of model combinations the sweep runs, and why each one is in the list.
why_not_every_combination: The full grid is 6 detectors x 3 depth models x 2 segmenter settings x 4 classifier settings x 2 anchor settings = 288 runs.
At roughly 4 minutes per run on an M1 that is about 19 hours, and most of those cells answer no question anyone asked.
Instead this is ONE-FACTOR-AT-A-TIME: start from a baseline, change exactly one thing per run.
13 runs, each isolating a single decision, gives more usable information than 288 runs where everything moves at once.
If two factors turn out to interact, add a targeted pair afterwards - do not pre-emptively grid.
_meta.how_to_add: Append an object with id, question, and args. args are passed straight to run_combination.py.
